sections.name: The corner at the week's end, as the game you play draws it (four pictures; tap one for full size). Still short of a 2026 game: few people and no cars; plain brick without burnt headers; the road's pale band by day; a clean street with little litter; the hill's trees read as lumps; Mickey's front very dark at night. Done from your midweek list: nobody in a white base layer in these frames, though the cast still wear it elsewhere in the walk; the hill has trees and houses; night buildings readable; the sky and quay end grey; more wear at street level. Which way next?
sections.recommendation: Keep going: phase 1's exit first, then next week's order picks from these shortfalls. This asks the direction, not a yes to the look: these frames would not pass in a 2026 game. No web link: the answer is this page.
